'''2006 World Championship Day 2/3 Brian Rippetoe DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Rippetoe]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (Day 2/3); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brian "X-Zipher" Rippetoe (2006-11-14).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35803 Rip's Day 2/3 CCT]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071109213014/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35803 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Shield slot 10 differs by day: Tractor Beam (Day 2) vs Restraining Bolt (Day 3); both listed.<ref name="src" />

== Original post ==

'''Rip's Day 2/3 CCT'''
* '''Author:''' Brian "X-Zipher" Rippetoe
* '''Published:''' November 14, 2006
* '''Rating:''' 4.96
* '''Description:''' My day 2 and 3 deck for worlds 2006

=== Strategy ===

This was my Team Tourney (2-0), Day 2(3-0) and Day 3(1-2 Loosing the 2nd tractor was big mistake) Deck.  This is also the deck I used to run up the differential on my Grandmother, via �Broken Concentration�.  It autoplays the first few turns except for profit so ill go over basic first 2 turns.

Turn 1:

First action go get executor

Second Pull the oppressive Shield

Third activate all u can

Forth use Special D to get Free Executor Effect (If its not there get Ive lost Artoo)

Fifth If you know Bespin is in there use 2 force and go get it

Sixth Drop the big bad ship

Seventh Go get Lando

Eighth deploy Lando

Ninth deploy the audience Chamber

Tenth save 1 force draw the rest

Some may ask why not get Lando at the beginning simple that�s 4 searches before u can drop the big boy that would give them enough draw/activates to recoil you, which is very bad for you.  If you have the lev attack use it to get tractor and a shield unless playing HB cannons then get 2 shields.  First turn your ship should be safe no falcon no lando 15 power and a destiny.

2nd Turn

First Activate

Second get Ive lost artoo unless you already have a tractor and a shield out in that case get flagship.

From here you deck can do anything you want the flagship will pull your 2 admirals and your other ship use the 2nd lev to mirror the executor.  The shuts and the in ranges own space. You have Epps for the ground attack if needed and a few battle interrupts to cause the damage.  Broken and Projective to mess with peps.  Tarkins orders is mainly to cancel drains or 2 drop you hand after you have the lock.  Now the best part of the deck is when you have pretty much won use broken to stop them from ever being able to draw up move the prize over and retrieve your whole lost pile.

Againts Profit start Zero Aliens Despair instead of Kuat Drive yards and retrieve 1 all game and deplay your executor a turn.

Well thats it for now it I can sneak away from doing work while I am at work I shall add more.
